a.lede: An Nvidia robotics engineer that quit in response to Jensen Huang's resignation says he "may have moved too quickly" now that CEO is back in charge.
a.title: Nvidia engineer who quit over Jensen Huang's exit says he 'may have moved too quickly'

b.lede: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia's office as CEO today to a crowd of applauding employees who stood and filmed the cofounder's first moments back. "Thank you all for the second chances. I'm gonna be a better CEO the second time around," Huang said, as shown in a video of his return. Huang resigned as CEO […]
b.title: Jensen Huang says he’ll be a ‘better CEO’ as staff applauds his return
